readerCopy.headline: Your life is getting bigger faster than your schedule.
readerCopy.body:
More people want your time. More plans sound worth doing. You may feel confident enough to take on a role, trip, project, or responsibility that would normally make you hesitate. The problem shows up later when three good ideas all assume they get Thursday, and the rest of your life is still waiting exactly where you left it.

Jupiter square your Ascendant can make your sense of possibility expand faster than the hours available to live it. The answer is not to play small. It is to stop treating enthusiasm as proof that the calendar will somehow make room. Choose the version that still leaves space for the life you already need to maintain.
doNotAssume: Do not assume a crisis, body problem, or that growth must be refused.
